svg.title: Danse macabre — Michael Wolgemut, 1493
svg.desc: Vector tracing of the Dance of Death woodcut from the Nuremberg Chronicle. Five skeletal figures dance and play music around an open grave. Original composition, ink hatching, and irregular border are preserved as filled Bezier paths. The scan's paper texture is omitted.
svg.metadata: Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Danse_macabre_by_Michael_Wolgemut.png Original artwork: Michael Wolgemut, 1493; public domain. Source scan: 705 x 599 pixels. Traced using Potrace 1.16 after 4x Lanczos resampling; threshold 0.55, turdsize 6, alphamax 0.8, opttolerance 0.15. All visible artwork is vector geometry.
